title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Lions D/ST solid in Week 8
items.desc: The Lions D/ST recorded three sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
items.impact: The defense made stops when it counted, allowing just 266 offensive yards in Sunday's win. The unit will look for another steady performance in a Week 9 contest against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Bates misses field goal in Week 8
items.desc: Jake Bates converted his only extra point attempt while also making two of three field goal attempts to record seven points in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings in Week 8.
items.impact: Bates has taken advantage of sizeable opportunities behind a high-powered offense, finishing with seven or more points in each of his seven contests. The kicker remains a reliable option for fantasy managers ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Miami Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Vikings D/ST does its part in Week 8
items.desc: The Vikings D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing one turnover in a 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
items.impact: The defense was unable to contain a physical Detroit ground attack, allowing 230 rushing yards and 5.9 yards per carry in the loss. The unit faces another stiff test against a physical Buffalo Bills offense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Will Reichard misses field goal in Week 8
items.desc: Will Reichard converted his only extra point attempt while also missing his lone field goal attempt in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
items.impact: Reichard struggled to make an impact Sunday, registering less than nine points for the first time in his last six contests. The kicker will look to get back on track against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cowboys D/ST implodes in Week 8
items.desc: The Cowboys D/ST forced two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) while also registering five sacks in a 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
items.impact: The defense was unable to make stops consistently Sunday, allowing over 200 rushing yards in a losing effort. The unit will look to take advantage of an underperforming Indianapolis Colts offense in Week 9.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brandon Aubrey misses field goal in Week 8
items.desc: Brandon Aubrey converted all three extra point attempts as well as three of his four field goal attempts to finish with 12 points in the Cowboys' 33-30 loss to the Cardinals in Week 8.
items.impact: Aubrey has been impactful of late, recording 10 or more points in five of his last seven contests. The kicker will look to offer another explosive performance in a favorable Week 9 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cardinals D/ST records four sacks in Week 8
items.desc: The Cardinals D/ST recorded four sacks while failing to force a turnover in a 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: The defense was able to stand tall when it counted Sunday, allowing just 288 offensive yards in the comeback win. The unit will be difficult to trust entering a tough Week 9 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chad Ryland misses extra point in Week 8
items.desc: Chad Ryland converted both of his field goal attempts while also converting three of his four extra point attempts to finish with nine points in the Cardinals' 33-30 win over the Cowboys in Week 8.
items.impact: Ryland has caught fire of late, recording nine or more points in each of his last three contests. The kicker will look to stay hot behind an Arizona offense with newly named starting quarterback Gardner Minshew behind center in a tough Week 9 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love has new ankle injury
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur told reporters RB Jeremiyah Love has a new ankle injury.
items.impact: Love will be further evaluated throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) seen walking without crutches or brace
items.desc: De'Zhaun Stribling was seen walking in locker room without crutches or a brace on Monday.
items.impact: Stribling has been on injured reserve since the season opener. He appears to be progressing, but remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Pearce Jr. completes eight-game suspension
items.desc: Falcons DE James Pearce Jr. has completed his eight-game suspension.
items.impact: Pearce is eligible to make his season debut in Week 9 against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendrick Bourne (ankle) could be out for season
items.desc: Cardinals WR Kendrick Bourne's ankle injury could end his season.
items.impact: Bourne had a non-contact injury with 21 seconds left in the first half of Sunday's game against the Cowboys. He is still undergoing tests.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) could practice this week
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said "it is looking more likely than not" that Terrance Ferguson returns to practice this week.
items.impact: Ferguson has been on injured reserve. He will have his 21-day practice window opened when he returns to the field.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dean Connors suffers broken hand, to require surgery
items.desc: Rams RB Dean Connors broke his hand and will require surgery.
items.impact: Connors will be sidelined indefinitely.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Grant Stuard (hamstring) week-to-week
items.desc: Grant Stuard is week-to-week with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Stuard hurt his hamstring in warmups prior to Sunday's game against the Chargers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent McDuffie (back) shows improvement
items.desc: Trent McDuffie showed improvement with his back injury on Monday.
items.impact: McDuffie suffered the injury in Sunday's win over the Chargers. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Watson aggravates shoulder injury
items.desc: Rams CB Jaylen Watson aggravated his shoulder injury.
items.impact: Watson will be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew Stafford dealing with elbow soreness
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay told reporters Matthew Stafford has been dealing with soreness in his right elbow.
items.impact: McVay left the locker room on Sunday with a bag of ice wrapped to his right arm.  He will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) will practice this week
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said Myles Garrett will practice this week.
items.impact: Garrett will have his 21-day practice window opened when he makes his return to the field.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bobby Hart elevated by Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks elevated OL Bobby Hart from their practice squad.
items.impact: Hart will add depth for Monday's game against the Bears.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Montorie Foster Jr. elevated by Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks elevated WR Montorie Foster Jr. from their practice squad.
items.impact: Foster will add depth in the wide receiver room for Seattle with Rashid Shaheed sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Robert Henry Jr. waived by Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks waived Robert Henry Jr.
items.impact: Henry was waived to make room for Jadarian Price getting activated from IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacoby Brissett officially benched by Cardinals
items.desc: Jacoby Brissett has officially been benched by the Cardinals.
items.impact: Gardner Minshew II was named the starter after leading Arizona to a comeback win on Sunday against the Cowboys. Minshew will start in Week 9 in Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gardner Minshew II named Cardinals starting QB
items.desc: The Cardinals named Gardner Minshew as their starting quarterback.
items.impact: Minshew came into Sunday's game and led Arizona to a comeback win over the Cowboys. He draws a tough first start in Seattle in Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) to be activated from IR Monday
items.desc: The Seahawks are expected to activate RB Jadarian Price from injured reserve for Monday's game against the Bears.
items.impact: Price will return after a month-long absence. The Seahawks will have a fully healthy backfield for the first time this season between him and Zach Charbonnet.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jevon Holland (concussion) practices Monday
items.desc: Jevon Holland practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Holland was in concussion protocol heading into the Giants bye week. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his status heading into Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Greg Newsome II (concussion) practices Monday
items.desc: Greg Newsome II practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Newsome was in concussion protocol heading into the Giants bye week. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his status heading into Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Theo Johnson (neck) practices Monday
items.desc: Theo Johnson practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Johnson was dealing with a neck injury heading into the Giants bye week. His presence in practice to begin the week is a good sign for his status heading into Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Abdul Carter not practicing Monday
items.desc: Abdul Carter was not seen practicing on Monday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reason is for Carter's absence. It's the first practice out of the bye week for the Giants.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices on side field Monday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo was practicing on a side field on Monday with trainers.
items.impact: Skattebo injured his hamstring on a long run against the Texans before the Giants bye week. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Mays suffers low ankle sprain
items.desc: Lions center Cade Mays suffered a low ankle sprain in Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: It is unclear how long Mays will be sidelined for. He will likely miss some time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jimmy Rolder (hamstring) out for season
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said rookie LB Jimmy Rolder will be out the rest of the season.
items.impact: Rolder totaled one sack and 11 total tackles over five games as a rookie.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eric Gray signs with Giants practice squad
items.desc: The Giants signed RB Eric Gray to their practice squad.
items.impact: Gray will add depth in the backfield for New York.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) expected to practice later this week
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur confirmed that Micah Parsons is expected to practice later this week.
items.impact: Parsons did not participate in Monday's walkthrough. He is expected to have his practice window opened later in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Campbell (neck) remains in hospital Monday
items.desc: The Lions say LB Jack Campbell continues to rest and recover at a local hospital.
items.impact: The Lions added that preliminary indications are positive for Campbell, a positive sign for the Lions linebacker.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kadyn Proctor still in concussion protocol
items.desc: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Kadyn Proctor is still in concussion protocol and progressing.
items.impact: Proctor's status heading into Week 9 remains up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Theo Jackson has quad injury
items.desc: Vikings S Theo Jackson has a quad injury.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is. Jackson is day-to-day for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Darrisaw dealing with shoulder injury
items.desc: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said LT Christian Darrisaw is dealing with shoulder soreness.
items.impact: Darrisaw will continue to be further evaluated. He is day-to-day to start the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Murray dealing with sore hamstring
items.desc: Vikings QB Kyler Murray is being evaluated for a sore hamstring.
items.impact: Murray is being fully evaluated to start the week. He is day-to-day for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brady Christensen to have practice window opened this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Brady Christensen will have his 21-day window opened this week.
items.impact: Christensen will have the next few weeks to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) could have practice window opened this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said WR Xavier Legette could have his practice window opened this week.
items.impact: Canales added that Legette still has some things he needs to clear recovery-wise. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Chiefs D/ST fails to force turnover in Week 8
items.desc: The Chiefs' defense allowed 28 points and 294 total yards. while recording one sack in Kansas City's Week 8 loss to the Broncos.
items.impact: Kansas City held Denver to 294 yards, but the defense failed to force a turnover and allowed 15 points in the fourth quarter. Jonah Coleman scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. One sack and zero takeaways resulted in a poor fantasy day for the Chiefs D/ST.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Harrison Butker makes one field goal in Week 8
items.desc: Harrison Butker made one of his two field-goal attempts and all three extra-point attempts in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8 as well.
items.impact: Butker connected from 45 yards before halftime before missing from 54 yards in the fourth quarter. The miss proved costly in a four-point loss. Still, Kansas City's offense continues to provide Butker with enough scoring opportunities to keep him in fantasy lineups.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (core) could have practice window opened this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said RB Jonathon Brooks could have his practice window opened this week.
items.impact: Canales added that Brooks still has some things he needs to clear recovery-wise. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Noah Gray scores touchdown in Week 8
items.desc: Noah Gray caught both of his targets for 15 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Gray caught a four-yard touchdown for Kansas City's final score of the game. That said, he had two targets compared to seven for Travis Kelce. Gray needs touchdowns to provide fantasy value as long as Kelce is healthy.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Travis Kelce records 67 receiving yards in Week 8
items.desc: Travis Kelce caught five of seven targets for 67 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Kelce finished second on the Chiefs in targets and receiving yards, including a 32-yard reception. Noah Gray caught Kansas City's tight end touchdown, but Kelce had seven targets compared to two for Gray. Nothing changed here. Kelce remains a TE1.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Xavier Worthy held to 13 yards in Week 8
items.desc: Xavier Worthy caught three of six targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Worthy had six targets but averaged 4.3 yards per reception. He has 13 targets over his last two games, so opportunities aren't necessarily the problem. The production is. Worthy has 86 receiving yards over that stretch and remains a volatile fantasy option.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) trending in the right direction
items.desc: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said OLB Jaelan Phillips is trending in the right direction.
items.impact: Phillips did not play in last Thursday's loss against the Packers. He is considered day-to-day.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Rashee Rice scores touchdown in Week 8
items.desc: Rashee Rice caught seven of eight targets for 53 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Rice led Kansas City with eight targets and seven receptions. He also caught an 11-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Rice averaged just 7.6 yards per reception, but that's secondary to the usage. He remains one of Patrick Mahomes' top options.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Emmett Johnson explodes for 143 yards, touchdown in Week 8
items.desc: Emmett Johnson rushed once for 15 yards while catching all five of his targets for 128 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Johnson turned a Patrick Mahomes pass into a 73-yard touchdown and finished with 143 total yards on six touches. So, is there a changing of the guard in Kansas City's backfield? No. Kenneth Walker III had 25 touches compared to six for Johnson. That said, 143 yards on six touches should earn Johnson more opportunities moving forward.
